children: RBI Swaps State Govt Bonds worth 10,800 cr Mumbai: The Reserve Bank of India conducted its first ever switch auction for state government bonds on Thursday. For a notified amount of 10,800 crore, the RBI received total bids of 11,188 crore. Bonds issued by the states of Madhya Pradesh, Punjab, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu and Uttar Pradesh were swapped at Thursday's auction, where the central bank did not accept bids for a bond by Punjab. NSE Gets RBI Nod for Bond Index Futures Mumbai: The National Stock Exchange (NSE) has received a no-objection certificate from the RBI to introduce futures contracts on corporate bond indices.

The approval follows an earlier NOC from the Sebi. The contracts will provide investors with an exchange- traded instrument to hedge exposure to mo-vements in corporate bond valuations. LG Electronics Sells 2% Stake in India Unit Mumbai LG Electronics has sold 1.36 crore shares, representing a 2% stake, in its Indian unit LG Electronics India through an open-market transaction to comply with minimum public shareholding norms.

The shares were sold at 1,765.26 apiece, valuing the transaction at 2,396.45 crore, according to NSE block deal data. No buyers were reported in the deal data. SBI Plans to Add 12k Employees in FY27 Mumbai State Bank of India (SBI), has recruited 1,540 customer support and sales staff from reserved category to fill the backlog vacancies across various states. During FY27, SBI plans to onboard approximately 11,000-12,000 personnel across clerical and officer cadres, factoring in retirements and emerging business requirements.

The planned induction of talent is aligned with the expansion of SBI's branch network by approximately 200-250 branches during the year. Blackstone Unit Plans to Sell 1.55% in IGI India Mumbai BCP Asia II TopCo, a Blackstone affiliate, is looking to sell up to 6.72 million shares, or 1.55% equity, in International Gemological Institute (India) through a block deal. The floor price has been set at 417 per share, a 1.48% discount to the previous close of 423.20. The deal is valued at around 280 crore.
